title: HARD-1: SIP-027 PORTCULLIS v1.3 availability hardening verification battery (6/6 checks: fail-fast unauthenticated rejection, per-submitter budgets, bounded ACK queue, receipt parameter binding, 20-slot regression guarantee)
description:
HARD-1: the SIP-027 verification battery for PORTCULLIS v1.3, the availability hardening amendment of the SQUIRL OS post-quantum crypto gate.

CONTEXT: BLIND-2 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23440105) showed that blind attackers converge on the availability axis. SIP-027 adds five deterministic amendments: A1 fail-fast unauthenticated rejection (anonymous frames cost the gate zero work); A2 per-submitter work budget (an attacker can only exhaust their own budget, never the owner's); A3 bounded pending-ACK queue with explicit receipted refusal (ERR_ACK_QUEUE_FULL); A4 receipt parameter binding (every journal record binds the full input parameter set); A5 KAT work under budget.

VERIFICATION: 6/6 checks pass - anonymous flood (30 frames, zero gate work), authenticated flood (bounded, 30 explicit ERR_BUDGET_EXCEEDED), budget-abuse control (owner ADMITTED while attacker exhausted), pending-ACK flood (cap + 10, explicit refusals), regression guarantee (the BLIND-2R 20 frozen blind-authored slots re-run against v1.3: 20/20 repelled, replay-regression control PASS - hardening does not reopen healed gaps), and receipt parameter binding.

HONESTY NOTE: the first run had a battery-scoring defect (a truncation in the check code scored a correct gate behavior as FAIL); the gate behaved correctly throughout and the scoring was fixed forward, disclosed same-day. Gate code, both journals, receipts, runlog and the full SIP-027 specification are in the bundle.

Dual Mesh Benchmark (scoped): MEASURED (DeepSeek column, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241); NOT MEASURED otherwise.

This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All data is synthetic.
